reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: EUR 60 million senior secured loan in favour of Lan-Oil LLC (the "Company"), a limited liability company established in Ukraine. The loan will enable the Company to build the first greenfield, privately owned, biofuels project in the Ukrainian energy sector since the beginning of the war. The Project is sponsored by JSC Concern Galnaftogaz and OKKO Group, a leading distributor of transportation fuels in Ukraine. The Project will contribute to Ukraine's energy security and energy sector decarbonisation by building a domestic source of fuel supply with 70% lower GHG emissions vs traditional fuel. The biofuel produced as a result of the Project is expected to be compliant with the EU Renewable Energy Directive (RED III).
